title: Bear with Cubs, Denali National Park and Preserve
author: National Park Service
changes: Brown bear (Ursus arctos) cubs mewling beside their mother in Denali National Park, Alaska. Used for the polar bear because no polar bear recording under an allowed licence was found; brown bears are the polar bear's closest relative. Trimmed to 0.35–2.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. US government work (NPS Natural Sounds gallery). Excerpt stops before a clipped transient at 3.2 s in the source. No high-pass: no measured low-frequency rumble.
